profile.headline: Software Engineer at Curtiss-Wright Controls
profile.summary: Software / Firmware Engineer with experience in Embedded Firmware and Application development and experience in the full life-cycle of the software design process including requirements definition, prototyping, proof of concept, design, interface implementation, testing, and maintenance.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Curtiss-Wright Controls is a global leader in precision sensor engineering, specializing in the production of flight and motion control systems, fire protection systems, rotor ice protection systems, position sensors and power conversion units for the Aerospace and Defense Industries.
• Responsibilities include design, documentation, coding, validation/verification of safety critical real-time embedded flight software for Military programs, within a team environment, in accordance with DO-178 standards.
• Code, including low-level drivers and communication interfaces (ARINC, CAN, SCI), is developed in C, in compliance with established coding standards.
• Documentation is developed and maintained with Requirements Management Tools (DOORS, Rational Change) and Microsoft Office Tools.
• Procedures for software configuration management are followed, using Rational Synergy, to configure software documents, software verification and validation data, and code.
• Participate in reviews of documents, requirements, design, code and test cases and results to ensure compliance with the established guidelines, procedures and standards.
• Interface, support and communicate with software, systems, hardware, validation and verification Engineering disciplines, as well as, customers and representatives of the agencies involved.
• Formal presentations are prepared and provided during software design reviews to customers and agencies involved.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Motion Technologies is a consulting firm that performs R&D, Design, Implementation, Prototyping, and Manufacturing of projects for the Industrial, Medical, Automotive, and Entertainment Industries.
• Worked on projects requiring knowledge of C and assembly for firmware development for platforms utilizing PIC and ATMEL processors, with development in the Microchip MPLAB IDE, and ATMEL tools.
• Software GUI development required knowledge of Visual Basic and C# development for the Windows PC and Windows CE (Pocket PC, Smart Device, Mobile) platforms using Visual Studio development.
• Communications and interface technologies included Serial RS-232, USB, F2F data handling and decoding, Bluetooth/Wi-fi data transmissions, data storage and retrieval, matrix keypad encoding.
• Projects included both new design efforts, as well as, support, re-work and enhancements of existing products and projects.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Mitutoyo is a leading global manufacturer of precision measuring tools and instruments.
• Responsibilities included designing, developing, maintaining and testing of Microsoft Visual Studio .NET C/C++ based graphical user interface software applications for 3D visualization and geometry solutions for Coordinate Measuring Machines (CMM), in a progressive team environment.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Greer Company is an industry leader that designs and manufactures specialized load monitoring,  control, and safety equipment for the Crane and Construction Equipment Industries.
• Worked amongst a team of Engineers, programming, writing test scripts, and providing documentation for firmware developed in C for Intel and ATMEL based processors using Keil MicroVision IDE and applications developed in C/C++/C# using the Visual Studio development environment, in accordance to International Organization for Standardization, ISO 9001 Standards. 
• Excellent communication skills and ability to interface with clients (included travel to client site).
• Provided support to Production / Service / QA departments through documentation, test procedures, technical knowledge, and maintenance and construction of test equipment and test fixtures.

educations.schoolName: Mark Keppel High School, Alhambra, CA

projects.title: Course Project - Chat Server
projects.description: ▪ Implemented a chat server and a corresponding chat client in Python. Chat server supports a wide range of standard features and commands, main duty to keep a list of connected users. Chat client hosts a variety of standard commands as well as maintains a buddy list. Provides multiple connectivity to client(s) and server. Implementation relies heavily on socket programming.

projects.title: Course Project - Compiler
projects.description: ▪ Implemented a compiler in C/C++ that compiles programs written in a source language consisting of subset of the Java programming language into the target language consisting of a subset of the C programming language. Lexicographical analyzer was developed with the use of lex (lexicographical analysis generator). Parser was designed with the use of yacc (parser generator).
